description: Amending the Promotion of Export Agriculture Act, No.46 of 1992
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-25 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Legal provisions have been made by the Promotion of Export Agriculture Act, No.46 of 1992, to regulate and promote the export agriculture sector in the country. Taking into account the periodic administrative changes and the changes in the sector, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meetings held on 2023-09-04 and 2025-08-11 to amend the said Act, which has not been updated in over 30 years. The proposed amendments are expected to revise the designations of the Head of Department of Export Agriculture and other officers and to provide a clearer definition of 'export agricultural crop'. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to publish the Promotion of Export Agriculture (Amendment) Bill, which has been prepared in all three languages by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Promotion of Export Agriculture Act, No.46 of 1992, in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
